mapping.summary: Prebuilt data warehouse and Power BI/Excel analytics for NAV and BC on premises.
claims: Prebuilt model with about 2,000 BI fields
Predefined Power BI dashboards for desktop and mobile
Excel used for ad hoc analysis on top of the model

Wizard to customize BI fields in five steps

Analytical layer on on-prem Analysis Services, Azure Analysis Services or Power BI Premium
Installs on your server without access to your data
Over 150 Power BI dashboards for web and mobile
Excel reports cover all standard areas plus Retail
